title: Finite-ring compact-support site comparisons respect refinements and towers
statement:
Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on ordinary constant-$R$ module derived categories of the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let all schemes be Noetherian, meaning they admit finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings. For a compactifiable separated finite-type map $h:U\to V$, choose $c=(j:U\hookrightarrow W,r:W\to V)$ and put $F_h^{t,c}=Rr_*^t j_!^t$ on site $t$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-asd-compactifiable]. Write $N_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and define $C_h^c=Rr_*^{\rm pro}(e_j)\circ d_r(j_!^{\rm et}(-))$, using the canonical open comparison $e_j$ and proper counit mate $d_r$ [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. For $E\in D^+(U_{\rm et},R)$ the map $C_h^c$ is invertible. For a proper refinement $u$ of $c$ by $c'$ let $\rho^t:F_h^{t,c}\to F_h^{t,c'}$ be the normalized proper-refinement comparison, the direct image of the proper/open refinement map $\alpha_u$ of [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison] on the etale site and of its pro-etale counterpart $\alpha_u^{\rm pro}$ of [lem-sp-refinement-coefficient-mate] on etale-origin pro-etale objects. For the composition assertion let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be composable compactifiable separated finite-type maps of Noetherian schemes, choose compactifications of $f$, $g$ and $gf$, and let $\alpha^t:F_g^tF_f^t\to F_{gf}^t$ be the normalized composition through compatible compactification towers [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] [lem-cbc-compactifiable-compatible-tower]. On etale-origin pro-etale objects use the corresponding proper/open pastes, with the pro-etale interchange $\Gamma^{\rm pro}$ of [lem-sp-proper-open-coefficient-mate]. Then
$$ C_h^{c'}\circ N_V(\rho^{\rm et})=\rho^{\rm pro}N_U\circ C_h^c,$$
$$ C_{gf}N_Z(\alpha^{\rm et})=\alpha^{\rm pro}N_X\circ F_g^{\rm pro}(C_f)\circ C_g(F_f^{\rm et}(-)).$$
Thus the computed pro-etale proper/open comparisons coincide with transport through $C$. These equations hold through every common refinement, and respect identity maps and associativity. They are natural in $E$ and impose no special coefficient presentation or assumption that the base field is algebraically closed. Schemes and Noetherian rings use [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring].

source.place: Tags 0F7I (lemma-shriek-well-defined) and 0F7J (lemma-shriek-composition). Agent site-coherence deduction using the separately stated refinement and interchange site equations.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sp-finite-site-word-refinement] to the proper and open factors of each chosen compactification. It supplies bounded-below etale witnesses, invertibility of the specified $C_h^c=B_{r,j}$, the normalized proper/open compositor equations, and the pushed-refinement equation. Substituting $r_1=r_2u$ and $uj_1=j_2$ gives exactly the first equation of the statement, including non-Cartesian refinement squares. The same lemma normalizes $C_{\mathrm{id}}$ to the identity. D9 formalizes invertibility and refinement by the proved refinement-plus inverse site equation. The common-refinement equation and change identity/cocycle follow by cancelling C and applying the etale refinement/change cocycles. Refinement identity/transitivity use the same cancellation. Identity normalization is proved by the proper and open unit clauses of the finite-site word lemma; adjunction uniqueness identifies both native etale unit factors, and naturality pastes them.

For the supplied compatible triangle T, destruct its three compactifications. Properness and openness imply that its intermediate schemes are Noetherian and its morphisms satisfy the finite-site tower hypotheses. Apply lem-sp-finite-site-tower-paste to its actual proper/open maps. Identify its etale arrow with the native bounded triangle comparison by embedding D+ faithfully in D and using the normalized unbounded triangle comparison. Identify its proper compositor with the specified canonical pro-etale direct-image compositor. This proves the site equation on T. Normalize the chosen etale compositor by the existing compact-support formalism and paste the three change-of-compactification site squares around the tower equation. Naturality moves the inner comparison through the change map. The resulting equation is finiteCompactSiteCoherence for arbitrary supplied c,d,e and T.

Use the common-refinement changes of lem-cbc-compactifiable-cofiltered and the etale compactification comparison cocycles. Cancel invertible site-comparison factors to obtain independence of the tower and naturality of the computed arrow. The existing etale formalism gives the left and right unit identities on the canonical unit triangles; the site equation and the already normalized comparison of identity maps give the pro-etale units. For associativity, prove abstractly that conjugating four compositors by changes of compactification preserves their associativity equation, including the copy along associativity of scheme morphisms. Apply this to the etale formalism. In the four composition site equations, move the outer comparison through the inner etale compositor by naturality and cancel the three source comparison factors. The two resulting paths agree by etale associativity, with exactly the conjugated witness retained by finiteCompactSiteCompositionAtWitness. These are direct categorical proofs; no general witnessed-descent theorem is needed.
